meta.title: ofa.js — Write Components as HTML
meta.description: ofa.js is a zero-build, zero-dependency front-end framework built on Web Components. One HTML file is one component, running directly in the browser — no npm, Node.js, or bundler required.
meta.noscript: This page requires JavaScript to run ofa.js.

footer.tagline: A zero-build, zero-dependency Web Components framework. Write components as HTML and give development back to the browser.
footer.note: This page is itself built with ofa.js.

tutorial/index.html.title: ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/index.html.description: A 20-lesson progressive ofa.js tutorial: from your first page to components, context, state, routing, and a full project.

tutorial/lesson-1.html.title: 01 · Your First Page — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-1.html.description: A page in ofa.js is just an HTML file: structure, styles, and logic all live in one file.

tutorial/lesson-2.html.title: 02 · Data & Interpolation — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-2.html.description: data can hold strings, numbers, booleans, objects, and arrays; {{ }} also supports simple expressions.

tutorial/lesson-3.html.title: 03 · Dynamic Attributes — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-3.html.description: Use attr: for HTML attributes and :prop for DOM properties; boolean attributes must use attr:.

tutorial/lesson-4.html.title: 04 · Styles & Classes — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-4.html.description: <style> in a page only applies to that page; class: and :style let styles follow data changes.

tutorial/lesson-5.html.title: 05 · Events — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-5.html.description: Listen to events with on:; use expressions for simple logic and proto methods for complex logic.

tutorial/lesson-6.html.title: 06 · Two-Way Binding — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-6.html.description: sync: keeps forms and data in two-way sync; it works best with scalar values.

tutorial/lesson-7.html.title: 07 · Conditional Rendering — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-7.html.description: o-if / o-else-if / o-else control whether content exists.

tutorial/lesson-8.html.title: 08 · List Rendering — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-8.html.description: o-fill renders arrays; use $data, $index, and $host inside list items.

tutorial/lesson-9.html.title: 09 · Editing Lists — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-9.html.description: push/splice on arrays update the view automatically; inline editing syncs directly to $data fields.

tutorial/lesson-10.html.title: 10 · Computed Properties & Watchers — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-10.html.description: proto getters compute synchronously; watch observes changes and handles side effects.

tutorial/lesson-11.html.title: 11 · Lifecycle — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-11.html.description: ready → attached → loaded, then detached on removal; clean up timers and listeners in detached.

tutorial/lesson-12.html.title: 12 · Your First Component — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-12.html.description: Split reusable UI into <template component> and load it with l-m.

tutorial/lesson-13.html.title: 13 · Component Parameters — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-13.html.description: Pass external data into a component via attrs; keep internal state in data.

tutorial/lesson-14.html.title: 14 · Slots & Events — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-14.html.description: slots let a component receive external content; emit tells the outside world what happened inside.

tutorial/lesson-15.html.title: 15 · Cross-Level Context — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-15.html.description: Share data across a component subtree with o-provider / o-consumer.

tutorial/lesson-16.html.title: 16 · Global State — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-16.html.description: When several components share state, create a module-level store with $.stanz and mount/clean it up in attached/detached.

tutorial/lesson-17.html.title: 17 · Pages & Routing — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-17.html.description: o-app manages the page stack: switch pages with olink / goto, pass query parameters, and go back with back.

tutorial/lesson-18.html.title: 18 · Nested Layouts — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-18.html.description: Child pages declare a parent, and the parent uses a slot to host them; the parent survives child page switches.

tutorial/lesson-19.html.title: 19 · Async & Loading States — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-19.html.description: Drive the UI with loading / error / success states for async requests, and never put async results in getters.

tutorial/lesson-20.html.title: 20 · Putting It Together: Todo List — ofa.js Tutorial
tutorial/lesson-20.html.description: Combine lists, forms, conditionals, computed properties, watchers, and localStorage into a complete app.

api/app.html.title: o-app & o-page — ofa.js API
